data.body: **[P2] Observe retry progress before checking for duplicate bodies.** `WRAPPER_ENTER` is emitted before the decorated invocation executes any steps. This predicate can therefore succeed while the second invocation has not reached `success`; the subsequent body count remains one even if that invocation later repeats the completed step. Teardown can also stop it before the duplication occurs. Wait for the second request's `BLOCKED` or `EFFECT` event from `controlled-io`, which follows the completed step, before asserting the body count. Add a negative control where retry progress is delayed after wrapper entry.
